announcement: v0.4.3 performance & architecture release: modularized main process, configurable queue concurrency & speed limiters, 44% smaller bundle, and throttled IPC progress.
features: Feature: User-configurable download concurrency (1 to 5 simultaneous download slots)
Feature: Bandwidth speed limiter with presets from 1 MB/s to Max/Unlimited
Perf: Code-splitting and chunk partitioning reduces main bundle size by 44%
Perf: Throttled IPC progress broadcasts to eliminate UI stutter during high-speed downloads
Perf: Web Audio visualizer loop now freezes when paused or minimized (0% idle CPU)
Perf: Hardware acceleration with Chromium GPU rasterization and zero-copy compositing
Refactor: Decomposed monolithic main process into clean modular services and protocols
UI: Clean consolidated engine status and tuning bar in the Download Queue drawer
